definitions.explanation: A glass-fronted cabinet or case used to display merchandise, food items, or collectibles. Common in bakeries, jewelry stores, museums, and retail shops.

examples.japanese: ショーケース⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: To choose a cake from the display case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝石店|ほうせきてん}→宝石店：28177_housekiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ショーケース⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧な⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Expensive rings were lined up in the jewelry store's display case.

examples.japanese: ショーケース⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{生菓子|なまがし}→生菓子：27039_namagashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|いた}んで→傷む：10061_itamu⟧しまう。
examples.english: If the temperature in the display case isn't properly managed, fresh confections will spoil quickly.

notes:
USAGE:
A widely used loanword from English. In Japan, most commonly associated with bakeries, patisseries, and delicatessens where customers choose items from a glass case. Also used for museum exhibits and retail displays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ショーケース⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ (to be displayed in a showcase)
- ショーケース⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in a display case)
- ⟦{冷蔵|れいぞう}→冷蔵：11731_reizou⟧ショーケース (refrigerated display case)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陳列棚|ちんれつだな}→陳列棚：17996_chinretsudana⟧: display shelf — an open shelf rather than an enclosed case
- {飾|かざ}り{棚|だな}: display shelf — for decorative purposes in the home
